captureNotes: Client quality setters lacked RobloxScript capability. Native Studio Performance simulation quality UI supplied the actual Q1/Q21 pair. The final option extended below the window crop; it was selected after reading that part of the screen. No device changes. Early files named final-runtime-lowest/highest-quality are failed-preparation captures and excluded. An initial video crop used the wrong Windows DPI awareness; its frames were discarded. The delivered recording uses the corrected physical viewport, 216 real frames at 12 fps, after loading. Game ScreenGuis were temporarily hidden/restored; capture camera helper removed.
preview: Existing isolated memory-only Studio preview; no profile writes, grants or discovery edits
